description: 🌿 Premium Private Boarding — One Pet at a Time 🌿 I offer exclusive, one-on-one boarding so your pet receives personalized attention in a calm, home-like environment. No rotating dogs, no overcrowding, just intentional, loving care. Hi! I’m Erica, a lifelong animal lover and experienced Rover sitter with years of happy repeat clients who’ve become true friends (both human and furry). Animals have always been my absolute passion, and caring for pets is something I take very personally. 👉 I'm fully insured through Pet Care Insurance, which also covers your pet while they're in my care - adding an extra layer of safety and peace of mind. • My Home & Family 🏡  I live with my loving husband, two daycare-age kids, and my 16-year-old cat, Samantha. I’ve also loved and cared for pets well into their senior years, including my sweet Bailey and Jake, who both lived long, full lives and remain forever in my heart. Because I have young children, I only accept pets who are comfortable around kids. My toddlers are high-energy, and I prioritize everyone’s safety, comfort, and peace of mind. For boarding requests, meet & greets are required so we can ensure it’s a great fit for everyone before booking. • Premium, One-Pet-at-a-Time Boarding 🐾 When I offer boarding, I provide exclusive, one-pet-at-a-time care. I do not board multiple pets from different families at once. This allows me to give your pet my full attention, reduce stress, and create a calm, home-like environment, especially ideal for seniors, anxious pets, or dogs who thrive on individualized care. If your pet is staying with me, I intentionally clear my schedule and remain home with them as much as possible. Your pet isn’t just another booking, they’re my priority.  • Walks, Drop-Ins & Visits 🦮🐱    I offer walks and drop-ins and thoughtfully schedule my day around the pets in my care. I respect your pet’s routine and take the time needed during each visit to make sure they feel safe, comfortable, and cared for.  • Communication & Care 📝     I believe great pet care starts with communication. I welcome any details about your pet’s routines, quirks, preferences, medications, or dietary needs…the more information, the better. I’m always happy to review written instructions and refer back to them as needed.    You can expect regular updates and photos so you feel confident and reassured while you’re away.

Our whole family loves furry friends, we want to keep them entertained and make them feel like they’re at home. We want to make sure we can provide 100% the utmost care possible for our furry friends. We will spend time playing with them all day, won't keep them locked in a cage, and we will keep you updated with pictures throughout the day!  I have flexible hours so I can dedicate my time to our furry friends. I can take them out whenever they need to, and accommodate any specific or special requests.  When caring for pets in my home, I provide a safe, loving, and stimulating environment. I ensure the space is pet-proofed, with plenty of room for play and rest. Pets receive personalized attention, exercise, and activities to keep them happy and healthy. I maintain a consistent routine for feeding, walks, and bathroom breaks, ensuring they feel secure and comfortable.

Dogs give me a lots of comfort and I love to give back to them. My son adopted a dog when she was a puppy named Daisy. She is 8 now and the only one. I have a big yard, with a brick wall, we live in a safe gated neighborhood. Dogs can go indoors and outdoors( backyard) freely and We also walk dogs a few times per day. When we walk my dogs can exercise and smell around in our beautiful neighborhood as well. I also have a very friendly dog named Daisy, who will be glad with company. We are dog lovers! I've always loved the joy and companionship that pets—especially dogs—bring into my life. Although frequent travel keeps me from having a dog of my own, caring for dogs on behalf of other pet owners fulfills my love for them. It genuinely brings joy and laughter to my family and me.   As a dedicated stay-at-home mother, I have plenty of time and attention to dedicate to your pet. My home offers a spacious yard, providing plenty of room for play and exploration. I also have two teenage daughters who adore spending time with dogs, ensuring your furry friend will have lots of company and care.   With extensive experience caring for the pets of friends and family, we’re confident your dog will feel right at home with us. We’d be delighted to look after your pet and shower them with love while you’re away!  Pet care naturally fits into my daily routine. Being at home most of my day allows me the flexibility to provide round-the-clock care, including regular walks, playtime, feeding, and cuddles. I could also devote a significant portion of my time and attention on them. My daughters and I enjoy incorporating pets into our daily activities, such as outdoor play in our spacious yard, relaxing indoors, and going on neighborhood walks. I absolutely adore dogs and cats! I grew up surrounded by animals, including two cats and a delightful Pomeranian that I personally cared for and raised from puppyhood. I have extensive experience in pet care and am highly responsible. I also have a keen interest in dog psychology and enjoy studying the unique traits of different breeds, providing a tailored approach to each one.    What sets me apart is my lifelong passion for pets and my deep understanding of their needs. My background includes hands-on experience with a variety of animals, from cats to dogs, and my dedication to their well-being is unparalleled. My interest in dog psychology allows me to connect with and care for each dog according to their specific breed characteristics and individual personalities. Outside of these hours, I am available to walk and care for your pet! Just let me know when you need my help, and we’ll find the best arrangement!  I live in a pet-friendly, gated apartment complex (photos available in the gallery). The complex features a lovely grassy area, perfect for playing and exercising your pet safely, so you can rest assured your dog will enjoy a secure environment. If your dog prefers longer outings, there’s a beautiful nearby trail where we can take leisurely walks for as long as necessary. This allows each dog to enjoy companionship without feeling overwhelmed, while I ensure that both pets receive attentive, personalized care. It’s a perfect balance for socialization and individualized attention, creating a safe and enriching experience for your dog!    I provide nearly constant companionship, as I am almost always home. However, for your pet’s safety, they should be comfortable staying alone for short periods without causing trouble, or you can provide a crate where they can relax during my brief absences.

Hi, I'm Kaylee. I've been caring for dogs, cats, and other exotic pets for over 12 years.I’ve rescued multiple stray dogs that turned into my family members. Our home environment is calm and structured to help dogs feel safe and comfortable.  My husband and two teenage sons also love dogs and understand the importance of being gentle and respectful with them.

I work M-F in a hybrid job and have some flexibility.   I’m typically open to weekend boarding/sitting requests and can be available for weeknight check-ins with some notice. Dogs have been a part of my life for as long as I can remember. Over the years, I’ve raised playful puppies, cared for sweet seniors, supported dogs with medical needs, and helped reactive pups build confidence, always with patience, understanding, and a whole lot of love. From the joyful chaos of puppyhood to the peaceful companionship of older dogs, I truly cherish every stage of a dog’s life!    My journey began at age 10, when I brought home my first dog, a gentle Golden Retriever named Tootsie. She was my best friend for 14 wonderful years and taught me the true meaning of responsibility and loyalty. A few years later, I adopted Frankie, a high-energy Pitbull puppy who kept me on my toes and taught me some tough financial lessons!! Frankie had a sensitive stomach, complex food and coat allergies, and underwent two TPLO surgeries. Caring for her meant managing medications, preparing a specialized diet, and making sure everything, edible or not, was safely out of reach. She was a handful in the best possible way, and I loved every minute of it!    I’ve also had the opportunity to care for a reactive family dog for several months, working closely with a trainer to build trust and navigate the world more safely. That experience gave me deeper confidence in handling dogs with a wide range of personalities, whether they’re anxious, shy, strong willed, or simply need a little extra patience and love.    My fiancé, Louis, didn’t grow up with dogs, but the moment he met Frankie, she became his biggest fan. As he worked from home, they spent tons of time together, and he quickly learned how to manage her medical needs and care for her in her senior years. Before Frankie, he had also helped raise his sister’s puppy, caring for her during long stretches while working remotely. He taught her the basics: crate training, potty training, and beginner commands.    Frankie's passing has been extremely rough on both of us. Though our home feels a little empty without a dog of our own, we’re holding off on adopting again for now, knowing full well we’d probably “foster fail” if we tried! That’s why dog sitting has become the perfect way for us to stay connected to the dog community. It allows us to open our home, hearts, and routines to dogs who need care, while giving their humans peace of mind when they’re away.    When your dog stays with us, they’ll be treated like part of the family — safe, loved, and surrounded by attention. Whether your pup needs a special meal plan, medication, extra snuggles, slow walks, or a comfy place to nap, we’ll make sure they feel completely at home.    It would be an honor to care for your dog and give them the same love and attention we gave to ours. We can’t wait to meet you both!  We’re currently available for boarding from Wednesday through Sunday, and we offer walks or drop-in visits primarily on weekends. That said, we understand that every pet and owner has different scheduling needs, and we’re always happy to be flexible whenever possible. If you have specific days or times in mind, feel free to reach out. We’ll do our best to find a solution that works for everyone.    We’re also more than happy to arrange a meet and greet before your booking. It’s important to us that both you and your pup feel completely comfortable and confident in our care. Whether it’s a quick visit or a longer introduction, we want to help make the transition smooth and stress free for you and your pup!  Your dog’s safety, comfort, and happiness are our top priorities. We’ve created a secure and welcoming environment where your pup can feel right at home—whether they’re staying for the day or overnight.    We have a spacious, fully fenced backyard that offers plenty of room to explore and play! The yard is mostly concrete for easy cleanup, with a large turf patch that’s perfect for lounging or bathroom breaks. For dogs who need a more contained space, we also have a sturdy dog gate that can section off a smaller area as needed.    Inside, your dog will be treated like part of the family. We keep a close eye on all dogs in our care and do everything we can to create a calm, positive environment tailored to each pup’s needs. When I turned 18, my three best friends surprised me with a Schnauzer named Pipi. He became one of the most important parts of my life.  I was lucky enough to spend 18 beautiful years with him before I lost him at the age of 36. Even now, I still don’t have the courage to own another dog, because he meant so much to me.  During those 18 years, I cared deeply about his nutrition, health, exercise, grooming, and happiness every single day. I truly understand how much love, patience, and responsibility pets need because Pipi was family to me.  Although I’m not ready to have another dog of my own, I would love the opportunity to care for and spend time with other adorable dogs. I will treat every pet with kindness, patience, and genuine love, just like I did with Pipi. My cutest boy ever  One experience that deeply stayed with me was when I was caring for two dogs for a friend during an unexpected emergency. Even while dealing with my own injuries, my first priority was making sure the dogs got home safely and were cared for properly before I went to the hospital myself.  That experience reminded me how seriously I take the responsibility of caring for animals and how deeply I care about their safety and well-being.  My love for dogs goes far beyond pet sitting. Besides my beloved Schnauzer, Pipi, who grew up with me, I have also rescued and cared for homeless dogs over the years.    One rescue story will stay with me forever. I saw a female Schnauzer on social media who had been stabbed 11 times and was somehow still fighting to survive. The moment I saw her, I took her to a veterinary hospital for surgery and decided to adopt her. The veterinarians estimated that she was around 10 years old and had likely been used for breeding many times. I named her Lala.    Lala spent the last five years of her life in my home in Beijing, surrounded by love, warmth, and comfort. She passed away at the age of 15, but I will always be grateful that I was able to give her a happy and peaceful final chapter.    Another dog I rescued was a small white poodle I found during winter, curled up inside a foam box outside my apartment building. I brought him home, bathed him, dried him off, and made sure he was safe. After posting a lost dog notice, I discovered that he belonged to a family in the neighboring building and was able to reunite him with them.    In 2017, when I was eight months pregnant and preparing to move to the United States to give birth to my son, I donated nearly everything from my Beijing apartment—including furniture, bedding, an air conditioner, and a mattress—to a local dog rescue organization. Because it was close to the Chinese New Year, I donated everything two weeks earlier than planned and ended up sleeping on the floor for almost a month before flying to the United States.    I genuinely love dogs and animals. I believe every dog deserves kindness, patience, safety, and companionship. When I turned 18, my three best friends surprised me with a Schnauzer named Pipi. He became one of the most important parts of my life. Even while dealing with my own injuries, my first priority was making sure the dogs got home safely and were cared for properly before I went to the hospital myself.  That experience reminded me how seriously I take the responsibility of caring for animals and how deeply I care about their safety and well-being.  My love for dogs goes far beyond pet sitting. Besides my beloved Schnauzer, Pipi, who grew up with me, I have also rescued and cared for homeless dogs over the years.    One rescue story will stay with me forever. I saw a female Schnauzer on social media who had been stabbed 11 times and was somehow still fighting to survive. The moment I saw her, I took her to a veterinary hospital for surgery and decided to adopt her. The veterinarians estimated that she was around 10 years old and had likely been used for breeding many times. I named her Lala.    Lala spent the last five years of her life in my home in Beijing, surrounded by love, warmth, and comfort. She passed away at the age of 15, but I will always be grateful that I was able to give her a happy and peaceful final chapter.    Another dog I rescued was a small white poodle I found during winter, curled up inside a foam box outside my apartment building. I brought him home, bathed him, dried him off, and made sure he was safe. After posting a lost dog notice, I discovered that he belonged to a family in the neighboring building and was able to reunite him with them.    In 2017, when I was eight months pregnant and preparing to move to the United States to give birth to my son, I donated nearly everything from my Beijing apartment—including furniture, bedding, an air conditioner, and a mattress—to a local dog rescue organization. Because it was close to the Chinese New Year, I donated everything two weeks earlier than planned and ended up sleeping on the floor for almost a month before flying to the United States.    I genuinely love dogs and animals. I believe every dog deserves kindness, patience, safety, and companionship. Caring for Pets in Your Own Home:  Provide a Safe Environment: Ensure that your home is pet-proofed, removing any hazards such as toxic plants, small objects that could be swallowed, or accessible electrical cords.    Regular Feeding and Watering: Maintain a consistent feeding schedule appropriate for your pet's species, age, and size. Always provide fresh water.    Exercise and Play: Engage your pet in regular physical and mental activities to keep them stimulated and healthy. This may include walks, playtime, or training sessions.    Grooming: Regular grooming, such as brushing, bathing, nail trimming, and dental care, is essential for your pet's well-being and hygiene.    Healthcare: Schedule regular veterinary check-ups and vaccinations. Administer any necessary medications as prescribed by your vet.    Socialization: Provide opportunities for your pet to interact with other animals and people in a safe and controlled manner to prevent behavioral issues.    Love and Attention: Spend quality time with your pet, offering affection, cuddles, and positive reinforcement to strengthen your bond.    Caring for Pets in a Client's Home (Pet Sitting or Pet Care Services):  Meet and Discuss: Prior to the service, meet with the client to discuss their pet's needs, routines, medical history, and any specific instructions.    Follow Instructions: Adhere closely to the instructions provided by the client regarding feeding, medication, exercise, and any other special requirements.    Maintain Routine: Keep to the pet's regular schedule as much as possible to minimize stress and disruption.    Communication: Keep the client informed about their pet's well-being through updates, photos, or messages, especially if there are any concerns or changes in behavior.    Emergency Preparedness: Be prepared for emergencies by having access to contact information for the client, their veterinarian, and knowing basic pet first aid.    Respect the Home: Treat the client's home with respect, keeping it clean and tidy, and following any specific house rules provided.    Professionalism: Conduct yourself professionally at all times, respecting client confidentiality and providing excellent customer service.
